title: Warm Gouda Qwen Pot Snack
description: A simple, comforting snack combining warm and light flavors with a creamy gouda cheese.

ingredients.name: Gouda cheese
ingredients.notes: Dutch or smoked Gouda works well

instructions: Toss the Qwen and light pot in a bowl with the warm, olive oil, and salt until they are evenly coated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
In a separate saucepan, melt the Gouda cheese over low heat.
Add the roasted Qwen and light pot to the cheese and stir until well combined.
Serve warm, garnished with additional Gouda cheese if desired.
